invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null list of HoodieRecord as an argument, as per standard usage of collections in method parameters.
The instantTime parameter is passed to downstream operations and should be non-null for correct operation.
Option (from the codebase) should not be null itself; it may contain a value or be empty, but the Option object is expected non-null.
The size of a Java List is always non-negative.
An empty instantTime string is unlikely to be valid for Hudi operations.
